name: kosmos-oden
description: Kosmos-Oden — explore an Obsidian vault as a 3D knowledge view, search it by words or meaning, and give AI agents read-only access through MCP (GKOS-Engine). Optional GKX governance, Graphiti export and Nextcloud WebDAV sync.

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && npm run check:versions && npm run check:lockfile && npm run check:artifacts && npm run check:invariants && npm run check:renderer-provenance
scripts.test:browser:chromium: playwright test --project=chromium --project=mobile-chromium test/browser/standalone.spec.ts test/browser/embed.spec.ts test/browser/context-loss.spec.ts test/browser/consumer-identity.spec.ts test/browser/standalone-flows.spec.ts test/browser/renderer-stability.spec.ts
scripts.test:browser:full: playwright test --project=firefox --project=webkit test/browser/standalone.spec.ts test/browser/embed.spec.ts test/browser/consumer-identity.spec.ts test/browser/standalone-flows.spec.ts
scripts.test:renderer: npm run test:browser && npm run test:visual
